# BurnBar

BurnBar is a native macOS menu bar application for monitoring AI coding-tool usage.

Official site: https://burnbar.scrubmac.app
Source: https://github.com/SyntaxFear/BurnBar
Download: https://github.com/SyntaxFear/BurnBar/releases/latest/download/BurnBar.dmg
Privacy: https://burnbar.scrubmac.app/privacy

Supported tools:
- Claude Code
- OpenAI Codex
- Google Antigravity

Core properties:
- Native SwiftUI menu bar application
- Local-first usage history
- No BurnBar account
- No analytics or advertising SDKs
- Signed Sparkle automatic updates
- macOS 14 or later
